simple.meaning: קְלָלָה (qᵉlâlâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “vilification.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 33 times across Genesis, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, 2 Samuel, and 7 more, beginning at Genesis 27:12. Its contexts include family, family line, commandment, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קְלָלָה (H7045).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קְלָלָה (qᵉlâlâh) / H7045 is traced through Genesis 27:12, Genesis 27:13, Deuteronomy 11:26, Deuteronomy 11:28 as a generated source-based concept entry.

and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God, but turn away out of the way which I command you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.

I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to live there, and they will all be consumed. They will fall in the land of Egypt. They will be consumed by the sword and by the famine. They will die, from the least even to the greatest, by the sword and by the famine. They will be an object of horror, an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.

Thus Yahweh could no longer bear it, because of the evil of your doings, and because of the abominations which you have committed. Therefore your land has become a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without inhabitant, as it is today.
For I have sworn by myself,” says Yahweh, “that Bozrah will become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse. All its cities will be perpetual wastes.”
It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Don’t be afraid. Let your hands be strong.”
